## Primary Positioning

Forward Deployed / Applied AI Engineer: builds production ML and LLM systems and takes them to
customers. Joins enterprise customer calls to explain forecasts and model behaviour, fixes
customer-reported issues, and implements customer-requested configurations across 30+ tenants.

Secondary positioning: AI Engineer, ML Engineer, Applied ML Engineer, Senior Data Scientist,
Forecasting Data Scientist, Marketing Science Data Scientist, ML Platform Engineer.

## LLM Systems and AI Agents

### Narovva: autonomous news-to-social publishing system (2026)
Retrieves and de-duplicates news, has an LLM extract a grounded structured brief (Pydantic),
renders carousels and motion Reels with captions and voice-over, and publishes on a schedule.
Multi-provider LLM orchestration (Gemini, OpenAI, open-weight models via OpenRouter) with per-model
quota tracking, rate-limit-aware retries and exponential backoff. Integrates 10 external APIs.
229 offline tests across 4 repos using fake model providers. Live on Instagram as @contextunfiltered.
Public package: https://github.com/CosmiX-6/poster-core

### Agentic video-production toolkit: 7 custom Claude Code skills (2026)
~3.9K lines of Python. Edits raw footage into an editable Premiere Pro project (faster-whisper
transcription, retake removal, assembly), decodes a reference video into a reusable style, scores
cuts against release gates, and uses a token-protected local bridge to drive Premiere Pro /
After Effects (ExtendScript) and Blender (Python). Model decisions are kept separate from
deterministic tool calls.

## Verified Impact

- Model MAPE in the 5–15% range through forecast category feature engineering; daily EOQ forecast accuracy of ~85–99%
- Modeling pipeline time reduced from 5–6 hours to 1 hour via joblib parallelization
- Migrated revenue metrics pipeline from pandas to distributed PySpark, resolving critical implementation bugs
- 25 production ML systems shipped end-to-end

## Key Projects

### Revenue Forecasting Platform (P01)
End-of-quarter pipeline and booking forecasting system. Production ML predicting outcomes at daily
frequency across 4 quarter horizons. Layers: time-decay adjuster, average-index fallback,
SHAP explainability, configurable multi-model framework (30+ parameters). Built and evolved 2022–present.

### Marketing Mix Modeling Platform (P02)
Full-stack MMX platform: BayesianRidge on STL-decomposed residuals, Hill Curve Transformer
(L-BFGS-B multi-start), adstock decay, PCA attribution, response curve generation, scenario planning.
Supports spend optimization and budget reallocation recommendations.

### Sales Pipeline Forecasting (P08)
Central projection system integrating 8+ ML model families into daily pipeline and booking
projections. Two-layer architecture: bottom-up propensity aggregation + top-down macro forecast scaling.

### Multi-Touch Attribution (P18)
Markov Chain MTA using removal-effect attribution. Customer journeys modeled as Markov states,
with transition matrices built from historical paths, enriched with firmographic and campaign
metadata. Daily attribution across marketing touchpoints.
